title: World Fairs
subtitle: Test your understanding of World Fairs — grand exhibitions of Tartarian tech and harmonic architecture erased by directed energy and replaced by the school story.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The World Fairs were grand public exhibitions designed to display the operational machinery of the previous overlay. Directed energy weapons pulverized that proof and the school story installed fictitious construction timelines. Seeing the deliberate destruction shows how free wireless energy was hidden and cognitive limitations were locked in across planetary resets.

options.rationale: Sound levitation technology was part of how the halls were constructed rather than the public purpose of the exhibitions.

options.label: B
options.text: The World Fairs introduced temporary plaster and wooden construction methods developed rapidly by colonial building guilds for short public seasons.
options.rationale: The sites were permanent high-density masonry with iron circuitry rather than temporary plaster halls built by primitive colonial builders.

options.text: The World Fairs were grand public exhibitions designed to display the operational machinery and Tartarian tech and harmonic architecture inherited from the previous overlay.
options.rationale: The World Fairs were grand public exhibitions designed to display the operational machinery and harmonic architecture inherited from the previous overlay.

options.label: D
